_doc: Curated module 4 case for gefitinib. The handoff itself is produced by module 1; this file adds the observed retry outcome and the evidence-quality block used for the paired comparison.

rescue.label: IPASS
rescue.enrolled_population: East Asian, adenocarcinoma, never/light smoker (clinical proxy)

outcome.basis: IPASS EGFR mutation-positive PFS HR 0.48 (0.36-0.64); FDA approval 2015 for EGFR exon 19 deletion / L858R.

evidence_quality.replication_note: EGFR-mutation sensitivity was established mechanistically in 2004 (PMID 15118073, 15118125) before IPASS, and the IPASS biomarker analysis was prespecified. IFUM (n=106) then confirmed prospectively in mutation-positive patients only.
evidence_quality.assay_threshold_note: Mutation status is a discrete genotype (exon 19 deletion / L858R) with a companion diagnostic, not a continuous score requiring a cutoff.
evidence_quality.registry_note: NCT00322452 posts full results including per-arm medians with CIs and adverse-event tables.
evidence_quality.hr_pos_provenance_note: hr_pos (EGFR mutation-positive PFS HR 0.48) was measured inside IPASS itself, in a prespecified biomarker analysis with both strata and both arms present. IPASS therefore measured the effect rather than being a prospective test of a carried-over estimate - which is also why the estimate was trustworthy: it was never extrapolated from a small subgroup with a tuned cutoff.

figure_wording.biomarker_phrase: a sensitising EGFR mutation (exon 19 del / L858R)

retry_result.label: IPASS, EGFR mut+, PFS
retry_result.note: prespecified biomarker analysis, both strata present in-trial
